ndvi_sentinel2.label: NDVI (Sentinel-2)
ndvi_sentinel2.source: Sentinel-2 L2A (10 m) via Google Earth Engine
ndvi_sentinel2.interpretation: Vegetation-condition proxy. NOT direct evidence of biodiversity, productivity, land disturbance, or environmental clearance.
ndvi_sentinel2.null_meaning: No cloud-free scene available for AOI

soil_moisture_index.label: Soil Moisture Index (NDMI-derived)
soil_moisture_index.interpretation: Relative surface moisture proxy, NOT a calibrated volumetric soil-moisture reading.
soil_moisture_index.null_meaning: No cloud-free scene available for AOI

soil_component.label: Soil component / profile name
soil_component.null_meaning: Map unit lookup returned no component

drainage_class.label: Drainage class
drainage_class.note: Screening classification; NOT equivalent to an NRCS drainage class.

mukey.label: Map unit identifier (non-US placeholder)
mukey.note: No national join key exists for this jurisdiction; value is an internal identifier and will not join to a national parcel/soil table.

soil_ph.label: Soil pH (1:1 H2O)
soil_ph.null_meaning: Source did not report a plausible pH

ksat_um_s.label: Saturated hydraulic conductivity (Ksat)
ksat_um_s.null_meaning: Not assessed — the source for this jurisdiction does not publish calibrated Ksat. Null must never be substituted with a value from another region.

soil_component_source_shape.label: Provenance of the parsed soil component record

map_unit.note: Nested object retained one release; consumers should read the flattened fields.

uk_drainage_class.label: Drainage class (GB screening)
uk_drainage_class.note: NOT equivalent to NRCS Hydrologic Soil Group.

flood_zone_ea_centroid.label: EA Flood Zone at the report centre point
flood_zone_ea_centroid.source: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning
flood_zone_ea_centroid.note: Point sample only. Does NOT describe the AOI polygon.

flood_zone_ea_aoi.label: EA Flood Zone intersecting the 100 m x 100 m AOI
flood_zone_ea_aoi.source: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning
flood_zone_ea_aoi.null_meaning: AOI intersection not evaluated for this report
flood_zone_ea_aoi.note: Where the point and area answers differ, the area answer governs screening decisions.

flood_zone_ea.label: EA Flood Zone (Rivers & Sea) — centre point
flood_zone_ea.source: Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning
